source: Two removal steps recorded as data. "unreliable": cells present in file 3 YYYY-orig and absent in YYYY-done (the ABS reliability step). "later": cells the rebuilt per-year yield has but the archive sheet YYYY-adjt (file 5) does not. The later step follows the diagnostic sheets in file 5 (one year only and far from the national value; two years only and under a tenth of it; Aver-val checks) but was applied with judgement, and no numeric rule reproduces it exactly.
